leadText:
A Week to Go and Old Wounds (Japanese: VS コバルオン・テラキオン・ビリジオン I VS Cobalion, Terrakion, Virizion I), titled VS Cobalion / Terrakion / Virizion I in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 506th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 46th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Cobalion, Terrakion, Virizion I (Japanese: 三剣 Three Swords) in the VIZ Media translation and A Week to Go and Old Wounds in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

In the original Japanese magazine version, 's motivation for capturing the Swords of Justice is to gather a force to counter Team Plasma's . When the chapters were collected into , it was changed to Black wanting to impress Drayden so that he may gain entrance into the without an eighth Badge.
